items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Me and Richard became tight. I started Richard playing...

ctx.x: Is that how you came to be introduced to Bud as well?

I met Bud because his brother wandered into the record shop. I was playing Bud’s with Bird on a recording. He piped up, after the guy bought the record and went out. I said, “Can I help you?” He said, “That was my brother on that record.” I said, “Who?” He said, “Bud Powell.” I said, “What’s your name?” He said, “Richard Powell.” I said, “You play music?” He said, “No.” I said, “Aw man, you ain’t Bud Powell’s brother. Get out of here.” So he – he was all dressed up in a painter’s uniform, with paint all over his…
